title: A local discriminant generator lifts into the stalk extension of the explicit section ideal.
statement: Let f:X→Y be a finite flat morphism [def-weil-finite-integral-morphism, def-weil-flat-morphism] of schemes [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions], with Y locally Noetherian [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring]. Let V⊆U be affine opens, y∈V, and b a Fin(n)-indexed basis for Γ(X,f⁻¹V) over Γ(Y,V), with the algebra structure from f. Then the germ at y of discr(b) belongs to the extension to O(Y,y) of the explicit intersection ideal I_f(U) [def-sbc-trace-discriminant-section-ideal].

proof.text: Index the free affine subcharts of U by the affine open, its inclusion in U, its finite rank and its actual basis. Use exists_affine_basis_of_finite_flat and localization of bases to common principal refinements to prove that these charts cover U.

At a point in two indexed charts choose a common principal affine refinement. Localize a basis from the first chart to it. Apply trace_discriminant_span_map_affine_restriction from both charts to this refinement and compose with its germ map. Ideal.map_map and germ_res identify the two discriminant ideals in the stalk.

Apply affineCoverIdeal_map_germ to this covering family of principal discriminant ideals and the stalk compatibility just proved. Identify its intersection of inverse images with traceDiscriminantSectionIdeal by unpacking the dependent indexing. The supplied basis on V is one chart in this family. Its discriminant belongs to the principal ideal and therefore its germ belongs to the mapped ideal, which equals the extension of the explicit intersection.

proof_origin.place: Tag 0BVH; compatibility on common principal refinements followed by generic quasi-coherent ideal descent

theorem traceDiscriminantSectionIdeal_germ_generator_mem
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} [IsLocallyNoetherian Y]
    (f : X ⟶ Y) [IsFinite f] [Flat f] (U V : Y.affineOpens)
    (h : V.1 ≤ U.1) (y : Y) (hy : y ∈ V.1) :
    letI := (f.app V.1).hom.toAlgebra
    ∀ (n : ℕ) (b : Module.Basis (Fin n) Γ(Y, V.1) Γ(X, f ⁻¹ᵁ V.1)),
      Y.presheaf.germ V.1 y hy (Algebra.discr Γ(Y, V.1) b) ∈
        (traceDiscriminantSectionIdeal f U).map (Y.presheaf.germ U.1 y (h hy)).hom
